manual_notes: Surgery anesthesia altered Drp1 localization but Drp1 was normalized to CRMP1.
BPA inhibited glutathione reductase activity.
Butylated ManNAc downregulated ST6GALNAC2 sialylation.
Arnica inhibited TNF alpha production but TNF was normalized to TNFSF12.
Gemcitabine increased MRP1 but MRP1 was normalized to CD9.
Montelukast increased TIMP-2 expression.
Saline was a control with non-significant PICK1 reduction.
Rapamycin decreased ET-1 expression.
Estriol inhibited TNF alpha but TNF was normalized to EDA.
Pycnogenol reduced MIP-2 but MIP-2 was normalized to WDR26.
Vitamin D3 compounds inhibited mTOR but the subject is vitamin D broad.
Selinexor downregulated MMP1.
Dex induced TASK-1 but the Dex identity is ambiguous.
Bortezomib induced HSPA1B but object normalization was incorrect.
Low oxygen increased PD-ECGF protein.
Capsaicin inhibited ANT2.
Caffeine induced Sonic hedgehog but object was IHH.
Myc was a transcription factor and THAP11 downregulated c-Myc.
Quinupristin dalfopristin altered TNF activity but TNF was normalized to TNFSF12.
Serotonin stimulated APLP2 ectodomain release.
MDA5 was a gene and not tenamfetamine.
Glutathione counteracted calcineurin degradation in oxidative signaling.
Ginsenoside Re lowered VEGF but subject and VEGFD mapping are uncertain.
Human defensins inhibited yeast growth rather than yeast affecting HNP-3.
Fluvastatin induced IL-18 production.
Curcumin reduced DMT1 expression but DMT1 was normalized to DMRT1.
PEG improved levels of mutant MRP1.
Celery extract was less potent but included in caspase activation comparisons.
Sulforaphane reduced tau and phosphorylated tau protein.
Paclitaxel decreased Mis12 level.
DFO changed HAT1 expression over time.
Urethane-treated STAT3 knockout cells had decreased CXCR4.
Butyrate increased mBD-1 but mBD-1 was normalized to DPEP1.
Metformin inhibited Shh-induced phenotypes rather than Shh itself.
Genistein promoted cathepsin-D transcription.
Actinomycin D caused SRSF5 cytoplasmic accumulation.
IGF-II stimulation increased DDR1 interaction with Pyk2.
Huperzine A restored TrkA levels.
DAPT affected Cdk2 expression but DAPT was normalized to the wrong chemical.
Tyrosine aminotransferase and HNF1 were gene list items not this edge.
Retinoic acid induced kalirin isoforms.
Ginseng treatment lowered HSPA1A expression.
Empagliflozin lowered caspase-8 cleavage.
Isoprinosine group beta 2-microglobulin increased but placebo also increased.
AU+ was part of a cell line label not gold.
TMP treatment activated HSF1.
Neomycin injury preceded Hedgehog overactivation.
Methylprednisolone upregulated PMP22 but PMP22 was normalized to PXMP2.
Thrombomodulin activates fibrinolysis inhibitor rather than the reverse.
Rosuvastatin increased LpA-I concentrations but LpA-I was not LPA.
Dexamethasone induced RP-8 transcription during apoptosis.
PAP appears to be pressure context not REG3A.
Parthenolide abrogated NTG-induced TIMP-1 reduction.
Doxorubicin downregulated CD10 expression.
Latrunculin B activated Slt2 but Slt was normalized to MCHR2.
HSulf-1 altered palbociclib-induced cyclin D1 accumulation.
Estrogen decreased carbonic anhydrase II expression.
Hydroquinone reduced GST-P-positive hepatocytes.
DMSO was a vehicle for estrone and inhibitor treatments.
N-methyl-D-glucamine was an assay method and ALP was normalized to ATRNL1.
Polydatin increased LAMP1 signal.
Green tea polyphenols induced Apaf-1 expression.
Benzodiazepine inhibited TNF production but TNF was normalized to TNFSF13B.
Enalapril reduced p53 expression.
Butyrolactone-I slightly upregulated Bax.
Chlorpromazine increased apoA-I levels.
TRAP was a stimulus and not SCYL1 affected by cGMP.
Valproic acid reduced TLR6 expression.
Coconut oil upregulated FABP1 but FABP1 was normalized to GOT2.
GW3965 induced Abcg1 expression.
Cisplatin increased SIRT1 expression.
FGF2 recruited Arp2/3 complex but Arp2 was normalized to ANGPTL2.
DDC referred to an expression group rather than zalcitabine treatment.
Adenosine suppressed Sirt1 activity poorly if at all.
Mtb means Mycobacterium tuberculosis not NCAPG2.
Buffer affected antibody detection of viral p55 proteins.
Indoxyl sulfate suppressed effects involving IL-10 STAT3 signaling.
CLA was cantharidin in this HSF1 inhibitor design context.
Clonidine downregulated p-Tyk2 expression.
DCA treatment altered Bcl-2 expression across cell contexts.
Zinc increased the A20-TRAF1 complex.
Cherry extract upregulated NQO1.
Dietary cholesterol upregulated CAP1 but CAP1 was normalized to TRAF3.
Pomegranate oil inhibited TNF-induced activation rather than TNF.
Pioglitazone attenuated cathepsin S upregulation.
Ginsenoside Rg1 reversed Bax increase.
Lidocaine decreased HIP protein.
Phenobarbital was a CAR positive control not a PPARD activator.
High-cholesterol diet increased MMP-1 expression.
Three-dimensional collagen scaffolds lowered Btg2 expression.
GHK-Cu decreased TNF alpha secretion but TNF was normalized to TNFSF12.
Butyrate decreased Col3A1 mRNA levels.
Soy isoflavones activated CREB signaling.
Thyme oil upregulated cho-1 but cho was normalized to TBCD.
LSD was a post hoc statistical test and ALP was not SLPI.
Gamma tocopherol docked against TNF but TNF was normalized to CD70.
GTS21 upregulated TXNRD1.
COP1 was a gene target activated by Cas9 and not glatiramer.
Methamphetamine potentiated p38 MAPK expression but p38 was normalized to GRAP2.
Hypericin blocked CREB pathway activation.
